purpose: Baseline metrics only; not admission, publication, new authorship or a fresh solution review of all 384 problems.
conclusion: The 72-row peer coverage is authentic but binds a 128-record unpublished revision preview, including 71 changed menus. The frozen solution review separately binds 128 full published records exactly. Every original series row has a truthful published-hash group/task map. Only 125 exact pinned visible tasks can reuse later task-level review, including two theta tasks; original theta family menu context prevents transferring full qualification. Zero fully qualified original baseline series Olympiad records are currently demonstrated by this evidence.
limitations: No fresh blind solving of all 384 problems; no human or player-calibration claim.
Same semantic hashes justify the same-mathematics lineage join, not menu, easiest-level or admission transfer.
Unsupported qualification means insufficient exact evidence in this report, not a proof that the mathematical problem cannot be Olympiad-level.
Recommended difficulty on 259 unmatched displays is explicitly the published-label fallback, not a new quality finding.

Choice order and choice IDs may differ where the literal math menu is the same; production shuffling makes author order irrelevant to this task equivalence, while immutable historical choice IDs remain unchanged.
The exact theta rank diagnostic is bounded to eight published cases. No general classifier or thresholds were changed.
